details.question: List the delayed projects of department 10130000 in fiscal year 2026, month 3, whose remaining unspent budget exceeds 19,575,000 THB. Show the top 10 by remaining budget with project code, project name, net budget, used budget, remaining budget and burn rate (used/net in %).
details.sql:
SELECT
  p.project_code,
  p.project_name,
  SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)) AS net_budget,
  SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) AS used_budget,
  SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remaining_budget,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) * 100.0 / SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)), 2) AS burn_rate
FROM projects p
JOIN transaction_statement ts ON p.project_id = ts.project_id
WHERE ts.dept_code = '10130000'
  AND ts.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND ts.month = 3
  AND p.project_id IN (
    SELECT project_id
    FROM activities
    WHERE is_completed = 0
  )
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name
HAVING SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) > 19575000
ORDER BY remaining_budget DESC
LIMIT 10

details.question: List the delayed projects of department 10130000 in fiscal year 2026, month 3, whose remaining unspent budget exceeds 19,575,000 THB. Show the top 10 by remaining budget with project code, project name, net budget, used budget, remaining budget and burn rate (used/net in %).
details.sql:
SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.project_name,
    SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)) AS net_budget,
    SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) AS used_budget,
    SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remaining_budget,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)), 0), 2) AS burn_rate
FROM transaction_statement ts
JOIN projects p ON ts.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE ts.dept_code = '10130000'
  AND ts.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND ts.month = 3
  AND p.project_id IN (
      SELECT project_id 
      FROM activities 
      WHERE is_completed = 0 OR is_completed = '0'
  )
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name
HAVING SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) > 19575000
ORDER BY remaining_budget DESC
LIMIT 10

  t.net_budget,
  t.used_budget,
  t.remain_budget AS remaining_budget,
  ROUND(t.used_budget * 100.0 / t.net_budget, 2) AS burn_rate
FROM projects p
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    project_id,
    SUM(CAST(net_budget AS REAL)) AS net_budget,
    SUM(CAST(used_budget AS REAL)) AS used_budget,
    SUM(CAST(remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remain_budget
  FROM transaction_statement
  WHERE dept_code = '10190000' 
    AND fiscal_year = 2026

WHERE p.dept_code = '10190000'
  AND p.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND p.project_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT project_id 
    FROM activities 
    WHERE dept_code = '10190000' 
      AND fiscal_year = 2026 
      AND is_completed = 0
  )
  AND t.remain_budget > 21750000
ORDER BY t.remain_budget DESC
LIMIT 10
